### Angry about the Wrong Things
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/angry-about-the-wrong-things-greg-laurie-daily-devotion-october-14-2020.html
Passage: Jonah 4:3
Points:
- Jonah became furious because God extended mercy to the Ninevites instead of destroying them.
- Instead of rejoicing over Nineveh's massive spiritual revival, Jonah turned inward and wished to die.
- Even after miraculously experiencing God's deliverance and preaching successfully, a servant of God can fall into bitter sin.
- Spiritual achievements do not make believers immune to crashing, burning, or harboring destructive attitudes.

### Undeserving Servants
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-august-16-2024.html
Passage: Jonah 4:2, 4
Points:
- Jonah attempted to justify his earlier disobedience while maintaining a double standard toward others.
- Although he had received divine mercy, Jonah resented God for extending grace to people he considered undeserving.
- God challenged Jonah by asking whether he had any legitimate right to be angry.
- Human beings have no right to question or restrict God's sovereign distribution of mercy.
- Resentment toward God's grace reveals that we have forgotten our own unworthiness.
